objectives: Identify the th-r onset in taught words.
Compare vowel patterns and endings in three, throw, and thrift.
Decode complete thr-words rather than guessing from the onset.

concepts: In these taught words, th represents /θ/ and r represents /r/.
The rime includes the vowel and following sounds.
Whole-word decoding checks onset, vowel, and ending.
